title: Vocational Nursing
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 30S/45Q to fewer than 60S/90Q units

why: the blocks sum to 54.6-54.6; the catalog states 56.0-56.0

program.section_heading: Certificate of Achievement in VOCATIONAL NURSING with emphasis on employment preparation
outcomes: Uses effective communication skills in the nursing role, in therapeutic relationships with clients and families, and in collaboration with the healthcare team. (ILOs: Communication)
Display competency in documentation of patient care issue. (ILOs: Communication)
Assesses basic physical, emotional, spiritual and socio-cultural needs of a client. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Formulate interventions based on assessments and provide safe competent nursing care using accepted standards of practice. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Evaluate care to determine priorities, goals, effectiveness of care, and the need for appropriate referrals. (ILOs: Critical Thinking)
Adhere to the nursing code of ethics. (ILOs: Ethics)
Practice within the scope of practice of a Vocational Nurse. (ILOs: Ethics)
Assume responsibility and accountability for managing own actions. (ILOs: Ethics)
Advocate for healthcare consumers through political, economic, and societal activities. (ILOs: Personal Development)
Utilize technology to obtain and document patient data. (ILOs: Information Competency)

notes: Read the Certificate of Achievement section on page 114 only; page 113 holds the Associate Degree section (Total Units for the Major 56, CMC GE 18, Minimum Degree Units 74), which was not used.

The Program Learning Outcomes are printed once on page 113 for the vocational nursing program as a whole, ahead of the degree section; the certificate appears to share them, so they are recorded here.
PSYC 003 Developmental Psychology (3 units) is treated as the closed-list PSY 3 Developmental Psychology despite the different subject prefix; reviewer should confirm.
VN 010 matched to closed-list VN 10 and VN 020 to closed-list VN020 (units not stored there; catalog prints 16).
VN 030 Vocational Nursing III (15.6 units), BIOL 022, BIOL 023 and HS 065 are not in the closed list and are marked as catalog additions.

The course sequence on page 113 lists BIOL 022, BIOL 023, HS 065 and PSYC 003 as prerequisites to admission; the certificate section lists them as Required Courses and counts them in the 56-unit total.
The LVN to RN 30-unit Option text after the certificate grants no award and was not recorded.
